name: Malsch (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and blue, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Malsch (an inverted white ploughshare on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Malsch; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Malsch arms — white ploughshare on blue
